issues.legal_issue: The civil procedure governing appeals, including its abatement and substitution deadlines, applies to appeals under the special ceiling law when that law requires the appellate court to follow the civil appeal procedure.
material_facts: The sole appellant in a ceiling appeal died while the appeal was pending.
His legal representatives applied for substitution, setting aside abatement, and condonation of delay more than 150 days after his death.
The appellate court found no sufficient cause for the delay and dismissed the appeal as abated; the High Court upheld that decision.
issues.conclusion: The appeal procedure required by the special ceiling law includes the relevant civil procedure for substitution and abatement, together with the applicable limitation periods. The legal representatives' application was late, and the courts below properly rejected it; the Supreme Court dismissed the appeal.
issues.legal_principle: Section 38(1) of the U.P. Imposition of Ceiling on Land Holdings Act, 1960 extends to appeals under that Act the civil procedure relevant to hearing and disposing of appeals. Order XXII Rules 3 and 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure govern substitution following a party's death at the appellate stage, and Rule 3(2) makes abatement follow when substitution is not sought within the time limited by law. Articles 120 and 121 of the First Schedule to the Limitation Act, 1963 provide the relevant periods for substitution and setting aside abatement. The fact that section 42 of the special ceiling law specifically applies only sections 4, 5 and 12 of the Limitation Act does not exclude those limitation periods where they apply through the civil procedure incorporated by section 38(1). No earlier cases are relied on.

predicates.special_ceiling_appeal: The proceeding was an appeal under a law governing ceilings on land holdings.
predicates.appellate_law_requires_civil_appeal_proc: The law governing the appeal directed the appellate court to use the ordinary civil appeal procedure.
predicates.party_died_during_appeal: A party to the appeal died while the appeal was pending.

issues.definition: When a party dies during a special ceiling appeal whose governing law requires the ordinary civil appeal procedure, the procedure's abatement and substitution deadlines apply.
